Executive Briefings

Create PowerPoint briefing decks for executive reviews with automated data from your projects.

briefing

Briefing Pack Export Router.

This module provides the API endpoint for generating executive briefing decks in PowerPoint (.pptx) format. The briefing generator produces standardized presentations containing programme health metrics, schedule visualizations, EVM S-Curves, risk tornado charts, and risk matrices.

Endpoint

POST /api/v1/reports/briefing/generate-deck

Accepts a project ID, reporting cut-off date, and optional slide selection flags. Returns a downloadable .pptx briefing deck with defence classification stamps on every slide.

Security

All endpoints require JWT authentication. The caller must have sufficient clearance to access the programme data being briefed. Classification markings are automatically derived from the programme’s highest-classified node and stamped on every slide.

Slide Selection

The slide_selection parameter allows the caller to request specific slides rather than the full 5-slide deck. For example, [1, 3] generates only the Programme Master Health and EVM S-Curve slides.

References

  • IPMR/CPR Formats 1–5 (ANSI/EIA-748B)

  • DoD 5000.02-M: Defense Acquisition Program Management
